picked.t: Easier entry, connectivity key for Vietnam tourism to compete in competitive neighborhood
picked.body: The country climbed seven places to 52nd out of 110 economies in the World Economic Forum's 2026 Travel and Tourism Development Index, its highest ranking since the Covid-19 pandemic. But it ranked behind major Southeast Asian markets. Singapore was 13th globally, Indonesia was 23rd, Malaysia was 26th, and Thailand was 38th. The expansion of visa-free policy for more nationalities remains an important feature of Vietnam's strategy to develop its tourism industry. Martin Koerner, commercial director of The Anam Group, a chain of Vietnamese luxury resorts, tells VnExpress International : "Vietnam should continue to make entry as frictionless as possible. Visa policies have improved considerably, but we should continue benchmarking ourselves against the easiest destinations in the region." Every additional administrative barrier matters when an international traveler can choose between Vietnam, Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia, and other destinations, he says. Vietnam has made it easier for foreign visitors to enter and stay in the country, including through 90-day e-visas and 45-day visa exemptions for citizens of 24 countries, including several in Europe. But the country has not yet waived visas for some major tourism markets such as China and India, unlike Malaysia, Thailand, and the Philippines. Vietnam also needs stronger air connectivity, with more direct flights from major cities in Europe, Australia, North America, India, and the Middle East as connections influence long-haul travelers' destination choices, Koerner adds. Dr Matt Kim, a lecturer in tourism and hospitality management at RMIT Vietnam, says infrastructure and accessibility require further improvement, particularly international air connectivity and transport links between destinations in the country. Long Thanh International Airport scheduled to begin commercial operation later this year will be transformational, but an airport alone does not create a destination, he says. Efficient connections between airports and tourism centers, better roads, rail infrastructure, and seamless domestic transportation will be equally important, he says. He wants the tourism industry to improve service quality and develop skilled professionals. "To compete more effectively with regional destinations such as Thailand and Singapore, Vietnam needs to improve not only its facilities, but also service standards and professional training." Environmental pollution is another concern, with foreign tourists frequently complaining about it despite praising Vietnam's scenery. Dieter Buchner, a German wellness expert who has lived in the country for 12 years, said Vietnam's tourism development should prioritize protecting natural landscapes and habitats, with stronger enforcement against pollution and waste dumping to preserve the environmental assets that attract visitors. "Too much of the countryside is being spoiled by plastic pollution. Every shocking image of a rubbish-strewn beach, forest or landscape harms Vietnam's thriving hospitality industry," he added.

picked.t: 베트남서 짝퉁 ‘발포비타민’ 유통한 제약사 적발…방부제 허용치 33배 초과
picked.body: 베트남 제약 업체 빈테크팜의 생산 시설 점검에 나선 공안들의 모습. (사진=하노이시 공안국) 베트남 수도 하노이에서 가짜 발포비타민을 대량으로 제조해 시중에 유통해 온 제약·화장품 제조사가 적발됐다. 하노이 공안은 “가짜 발포정 120만여 정을 제조·유통해 온 베트남 제약·화장품 업체 빈테크팜(Vintechpharm)의 응우옌 테 빈(Nguyen The Vinh) 대표를 포함, 용의자 4명을 식품위조 및 유통 혐의로 입건했다”고 5일 밝혔다. 이 사건은 빈테크팜이 신고 내용과 다른 건강기능식품을 제조·판매하고 있다는 정황을 수사 당국이 포착하면서 드러났다. 현재 빈 대표는 구속 수사를 받고 있다. 베트남 하노이 공안이 방부제인 안식향산나트륨(sodium benzoate)이 허용치의 최대 33배 검출된 가짜 발포정 120만 정 이상을 제조·판매한 혐의로 제약·화장품 제조업체 빈테크팜(Vintechpharm)의 응우옌테빈 대표를 구금했다. 하노이 공안 당국은 빈테크팜을 대상으로 일정 기간 내사를 벌인 뒤, 지난 8월 17일 지역 경찰과 관계 기관으로 구성된 합동 단속반을 통해 관내에 위치한 해당 업체 생산 시설에 대한 점검에 나섰다. 단속반은 제품 신고서의 정보가 실제 제품 라벨과 일치하지 않고, 제품 등록 서류도 제대로 갖추지 못했다는 점을 확인했다. 이후 단속반은 해당 생산 시설과 동사의 거래처인 약국 및 판매점 3곳에서 발포정 120만 정 이상을 압수·봉인했다. 이후 전문 검사 기관이 빈테크팜에서 생산된 발포정 시료 4건을 분석한 결과, 방부제인 안식향산나트륨이 4.18~6.78% 농도로 검출됐다. 허용치가 0.2% 이하인 점을 감안하면, 20~33배 높은 농도다. 또한 라벨에 표기된 비타민 B1·B3·B6 등 일부 성분과 다른 유효성분은 시료에서 검출되지 않았다. 그러나 이 제품들은 △면역력 증진 △해독 △간열 해소 등에 도움이 된다고 광고됐으며, 어린이 또한 주요 사용 대상으로 명시됐다. 동사가 생산한 제품들의 명칭은 ‘멀티비타민프로(Multivitamin Pro)’, ‘악티소프로(Actiso Pro)’, 악티소라우응오-라우마(Actiso Rau Ngo-Rau Ma)’ 등으로, 생산원가는 개당 1만 동(38센트)에 미치지 못했으나, 실제로는 약국과 틱톡숍, 쇼피 등 전자상거래 플랫폼을 통해 4만5,000~6만 동(1.7~2.3달러)에 판매된 것으로 드러났다. 하노이 공안 당국은 이번 사건에 연루된 다른 개인·단체의 역할을 규명하기 위해 수사를 확대하고 있다. 공안 당국은 “빈테크팜이 공급한 위 제품을 구매하거나 사용한 개인·단체는 수사 협조를 위해 공안국에 연락해 정보를 제공해달라”고 요청했다.

picked.t: 베트남서 ‘100억 원대’ 로또 당첨자 1명 탄생…역대 최대 당첨금
picked.body: (이미지=비엣로트 메가 6/45 추첨결과 갈무리) 베트남에서 역대 최대 규모 당첨금의 로또복권 당첨자가 나와 많은 관심을 받고 있다. 당첨금은 원화 100억 원대인데 더 놀라운 것은 당첨자가 단 1명이라는 사실이다. 베트남 국영 로또사업자 비엣로트(Vietlott)는 지난 4일 메가 6/45(Mega 6/45) 1571회차 추첨에서 잭폿(Jackpot) 당첨자 1명이 나왔다고 밝혔다. 당첨 번호는 15-20-29-37-40-45로, 지난 두 달 26회 추첨 동안 당첨자가 나오지 않아 이월을 거듭한 끝에 당첨금은 1,995억 동(약 770만 달러)까지 불어났다. 이는 메가 6/45 출시 이후 10년 만에 최대 당첨금에 해당한다. 직전 최고액은 1,590억 동(610만여 달러)이었으나, 당시에는 2명이 당첨돼 절반씩 나눠 가졌다. 당첨자는 규정에 따라 소득세 공제 뒤 약 1,800억 동(690만여 달러)을 수령하게 된다. 당첨자 정보와 당첨 복권이 판매된 곳은 공개되지 않았다. 추첨 방식에 따라, 다음 회차부터 메가 6/45 잭폿 당첨금은 120억 동(46.1만 달러)부터 다시 시작한다. 메가 6/45는 파워 6/55와 더불어 비엣로트의 주력사업 중 하나로, 전체 45개 숫자중 6개 번호를 맞추는 베트남판 로또 복권이다. 한편, 로또사업자인 비엣로트는 재무부가 100% 출자한 국영 복권회사로, 현재 7종의 복권 상품을 판매하고 있다. 이 중 메가 6/45는 지난 2016년 7월 처음 출시됐다. 현재 베트남 내 복권회사는 모두 63곳으로 각 성·시 인민위원회가 설립·운영을 맡고 있다. 국영기업인 비엣로트는 전국적인 복권 사업을 영위하고 있다. 앞서 재무부가 발표한 복권 영업 관련 시행규칙 시행 13년 결산보고서에 따르면, 2013~2025년 기간 베트남 내 복권 판매액은 누적 1,370조 동(526억8,620만여 달러)을 넘어섰다. 베트남인들의 복권 구매액이 연평균 106조 동(약 40억7,650만 달러)에 달한 셈이다.

picked.t: British man stranded in forest rescued by police, praises Vietnam's kindness
picked.body: Mattacott, who works as a marketing specialist in Vietnam, was riding a Kawasaki W650 around noon on Oct. 3 when, following directions from Google Maps, he turned onto a dirt road through the mountains and forest in Dang Thuy Tram Commune, Quang Ngai Province. The road became increasingly difficult, with steep sections, rough rocks and mud. In some places, the motorcycle sank halfway into the mud. Eventually, the bike suffered a flat tire on a rocky slope. Mattacott spent more than three hours walking while pushing his motorcycle in search of a way out. At around 2:30 p.m., local residents found him in the Kon Doc area and alerted commune police. Lieutenant Colonel Phan Tien Dung, head of Dang Thuy Tram Commune Police, and Captain Pham Trung Tien then drove a specialized vehicle to assist him. The two officers loaded Mattacott and his motorcycle onto their vehicle and drove them nearly 20 km to the nearest residential area, where he could find a repair shop. After the tire was repaired, the officers continued to escort Mattacott to a main road so he could resume his journey. In a handwritten letter in English acquired by VnExpress , Mattacott thanked the local residents and police for helping him. He said he got lost while riding from Quy Nhon to Da Nang and found himself "on very rough road on the mountain." He was "very worried" that he could not find any help. "Some kind local people called the police to help me. The police were so friendly and helpful." "I don't think I would have been treated so well in any other country I have been to," he wrote. Mattacott has been coming to Vietnam since late 2019 and usually travels by motorcycle. He said he has traveled to 34 countries and dealt with plenty of police officers, but his experience with the two Vietnamese officers in Quang Ngai "ranks among the very best." Lieutenant Colonel Dung said the dirt road connecting the An Lao area of Gia Lai with Dang Thuy Tram Commune is mainly used by local residents and for forestry activities. The route has many steep and rocky sections, making it easy for people unfamiliar with the terrain to get lost. Before Mattacott, tourists from Canada, China, South Korea and the U.S. had also been directed onto the same road by Google Maps while traveling from Quy Nhon to Da Nang. Dang Thuy Tram Commune Police advised tourists unfamiliar with the terrain to avoid the road, particularly during the rainy season, when muddy conditions, landslides and road isolation are more likely.

picked.t: 8 garden cafes to enjoy Hanoi autumn
picked.body: Hanoi is experiencing its most beautiful time of the year, making it ideal for a leisurely sip of coffee. Several of these open-air cafés have been operating for the last two or three years and receiving high praise on culinary and travel forums. Tranquil Cao Ba Quat Tranquil Cao Ba Quat is part of a chain of four coffee shops in Hanoi. The place has a small, serene garden area with trees and a minimalist decor. The highlight of Tranquil is the serenity, which is ideal for reading, working, or spending time alone. Its menu has teas, machine-brewed coffees, matcha lattes, and light bites such as waffles and ice cream. Guests are gently told to keep their voices down. Beverages range from VND40,000 to VND80,000 (US$1.5-3). Address: 19 Cao Ba Quat Street, Ba Dinh Ward Thu Garden Cafe The café stands out for its green space featuring layered foliage, small yards, and a nature-inspired seating arrangement. It is compact and relatively private, making it ideal for lingering over a long conversation, reading, or working, rather than just dropping by for a quick coffee. The menu starts at VND45,000. Address: No. 19, Alley 67 To Ngoc Van Street, Tay Ho Ward Philo Garden Cafe & Tea Philo Garden Cafe & Tea is ideal for those looking for a lush, cool oasis to relax in the middle of the city. The café impresses with its abundant greenery, and has tables arranged in garden areas and private corners. Early mornings or late afternoons are when the outdoor area is most pleasant, especially during autumn. The beverage menu ranges from VND30,000 to VND60,000. Address: No. 11, Alley 5 Tu Hoa Street, Tay Ho Ward Tin Ca phe The café is divided into various areas ranging from outdoor gardens and fish ponds to a glasshouse. The highlight is its greenery, which almost creates the feeling if being on a small island. The combination of old fruit trees, tropical shrubs, and low vegetation creates a multi-layered, cool green space. The beverages on offer range from coffees and teas to matcha and fruit juices. The shop also serves some light snacks such as biscotti and croissants. Prices range from VND40,000 to VND65,000 for beverages, with machine-brewed coffee starting at VND40,000, teas costing VND55,000, and matcha costing VND65,000. Address: 32 Do Xuan Hop Street, Tu Liem Ward Mono Coffee Mono Coffee embraces a minimalist spirit, making it suitable for those looking for some peace and quiet amidst the urban hustle and bustle. The café has neutral color palettes, minimalist interior details, and soft lighting, creating an easy and soothing feeling. Both its locations, one on Nguyen Dinh Chieu Street and the other on Nguyen Huy Tu Street, also have large, green gardens. The menu focuses on coffee and familiar beverages, with prices ranging from VND35,000 to VND85,000. Addresses: No. 19, Alley 101 Nguyen Dinh Chieu Street and 3 Nguyen Huy Tu Street, Hai Ba Trung Ward Thieu So Tra & Ca Phe The shop focuses on teas and coffees, but creates a unique vibe with its indigenous-inspired space, artisanal details, natural materials, and minimalist decor. Prices range from VND40,000 to VND70,000. The space is private enough for reading and working, while also offering plenty of corners to chat with friends. Natural lighting, greenery, and open spaces make the café especially pleasant on days when Hanoi transitions from summer to autumn. Address: 8 Huynh Thuc Khang Street, Dong Da Ward Dieu House Bar & Coffee Situated on Ngoc Thuy Street on a triangular plot of land near the Duong River, Dieu House stands out with its rustic yellow walls, brown tiled roofs, wooden structures, and decorative items collected from various places. Dieu House has a diverse menu with cocktails, coffee, and tea. Prices start at VND50,000, and a photography fee of VND350,000 applies for guests taking photos. Address: No. 20, Alley 465 Ngoc Thuy Street, Bo De Ward Hai Tam Hon Coffee The café, whose name means "two souls", has a minimalist design, greenery, open spaces, and comfortable seating. The menu offers plenty of options ranging from coffees and teas to refreshing drinks. The shop places a strong emphasis on flavor balance, and has a selection of light snacks to pair with the beverages. Although not too large, the café's biggest asset is its direct views overlooking Hoang Cau Lake. Drinks start from VND45,000. Address: 96 Mai Anh Tuan, Dong Da Ward
